sources.snippet: Overview gpt2-large is a 774M parameter transformer-based language model developed by openai-community that generates English text using causal language modeling. Built on the GPT-2 architecture, this model predicts the next token in a sequence and supports both PyTorch and TensorFlow through the Hugging Face Transformers library.
